  \]

- Uplift:
  \[
  p_{heel}=0.75\gamma_w H_w=0.75(9.81)(12)=88.29\text{ kPa}

  \]
  Acts at \(2B/3 = 2(6.27)/3 = 4.18\text{ m}\) from toe:
  \[

  \]

\]

  W_1=24(3.4)(13)=1060.8\text{ kN}

  \[

  \]
  \[
  M_1=1060.8\times 4.57=4847.86\text{ kN·m}

  \]

\]
